overview.description: Sviten Special (also called Drawmaha) is a Swedish split-pot poker game that combines 5-Card Draw and Pot-Limit Omaha. Each player is dealt 5 cards. There is a Flop, Turn, and River. After the Flop betting, players can discard and draw new cards to their hand (Draw Poker rules). The twist: If you draw ONE card, it is dealt face-up (or you can reject it and take a face-down one). The pot is split between the best 5-card hand (private) and the best Omaha hand (2 private + 3 board).

history.origins: As reported by Jonas Uebel, Sviten Special became very popular in the Nordic countries and is widely believed to have originated in 2004 at Anders Bengtsson's legendary Sviten poker club in Stockholm. An identical game was played in French Canada in the 1980s as Celestial Poker (Céleste); a similar game is played in the USA as Drawmaha, suggesting the idea arose independently in several places.
history.evolution: The 'One Card Open' rule is the signature Sviten mechanic.

setup.players: Five to seven players; optimum is 5 or 6. Up to 9 can play but the deck may need recycling from the muck for replacements.
setup.deck: Standard international 52-card deck (four suits, Ace through King).
setup.dealing: Deal 5 cards each. Small Blind/Big Blind.

rules.objective: Win chips by having the best five-card hand (from your five private cards) and the best Omaha hand (two of your cards plus three board cards) at showdown; the pot is split between these two halves.
rules.gameplay: Blinds are posted. Each player receives five cards and a pre-flop betting round follows. Dealer burns one and deals three community cards (flop); second betting round. Each player may then discard zero to five cards and receive that many replacements from the deck. Dealer burns one and deals the turn card; third betting round. Dealer burns one and deals the river; fourth betting round. At showdown the pot is split between the best five-card hand (private cards only) and the best Omaha hand (exactly two hole cards plus exactly three board cards).
keyRules: Pot limit betting. Blinds and order as in Texas Hold'em and Omaha.
After the flop betting round, each player may discard 0-5 cards and receive an equal number of replacements.
Pot splits between best five-card hand (all five in hand) and best Omaha hand (two from hand, three from board).
Standard poker hand rankings for both halves. One player can scoop the entire pot by winning both halves.

strategy.basic: Start with hands that play well both ways (e.g., A-K-Q-J-10 double suited). Don't draw blindly for a flush if it ruins your Omaha hand. The 'One Open' card gives info to everyoneâ€”if you draw an Ace face-up, everyone knows you have it.
strategy.intermediate: Scooping: You need to win both halves. If you have the Nut Flush in Omaha, and a Pair in hand, you might win half. But Quads in hand and nothing in Omaha is also half. Aim for both.
strategy.advanced: Blockers: Since you see discarded/open cards, use that info. If an opponent draws 1 card and gets a King face-up, you know one King is gone.
tips: Don't fold a Pat Hand too easily.

list.name: One card face-up
list.description: When exchanging only one card, the replacement may be dealt face up; the player may accept it or reject it and receive a face-down card instead.
list.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes draw visibility; no engine constant overrides needed.

list.name: Communist Pot
list.description: Everyone antes 5x the big blind; no betting round after the initial deal - the flop is dealt immediately.
list.emptyOverridesReason: Variant changes ante and skips pre-flop bet; overrides can be added when implementing.

list.name: Roll Your Own
list.description: Each player reveals one of their five cards when the turn is dealt (before third betting round) and a second when the river is dealt (before final betting round).
list.emptyOverridesReason: Variant changes card visibility timing; overrides can be added when implementing.

difficulty.hard: Expert 'Sviten-Shark'; calculates equity for both pots simultaneously; exploits the 'One Open' info leakage; aggresses on freerolls.

phases.label: Deal
phases.notes: Dealer deals five hole cards to each player.

phases.label: Pre-flop betting
phases.notes: First betting round; player left of big blind acts first.

phases.label: Flop
phases.notes: Dealer burns one card and deals three community cards face up.

phases.label: Flop betting
phases.notes: Second betting round; player left of dealer acts first.

phases.label: Draw and replace
phases.notes: Each player may discard 0-5 cards and receive an equal number of replacements from the deck.

phases.label: Turn
phases.notes: Dealer burns one card and deals one community card (fourth street).

phases.label: River
phases.notes: Dealer burns one card and deals one community card (fifth street).

phases.label: Showdown
phases.notes: Pot is split between best five-card hand (private) and best Omaha hand (two hole plus three board).

ante.reason: Base game uses blinds only; ante appears only in Communist Pot variation.

deal.description: Deal five hole cards face down to each player.
deal.constraints: Dealer only; performed at start of hand.

reveal_market.reason: This game does not use a market to reveal.

buy_market.reason: This game has no market purchase.

buy_stock.reason: This game has no buying from stock.

fold.description: Fold and forfeit the hand; no further action in the pot.
fold.constraints: Legal when it is your turn in a betting round.

check.description: Check: decline to bet and pass action to the next player.
check.constraints: Legal only when no bet has been made in the current round (or you have already matched the current bet).

call.description: Call: match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made and you have not yet matched it.

bet.description: Place a bet; amount subject to pot limit.
bet.constraints: Legal when no bet has been made in the current round; maximum bet is the current pot size (pot limit).

raise.description: Raise: increase the current bet up to the pot size.
raise.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made; raise amount is limited to current pot (pot limit).

declare.reason: This game has no declare phase.

reveal_hand.description: Reveal all five hole cards at showdown. Pot is split between best five-card hand and best Omaha hand (two hole plus three board).
reveal_hand.constraints: Legal at showdown when you are an active player.

award_pot.reason: This game has no pot to award.

play_card.reason: Sviten Special has no card play to the table during rounds; only betting, draw replacement, and showdown.

draw.description: Receive replacement cards from the dealer after discarding in the draw_replace phase. Number received equals number discarded (0-5).
draw.constraints: Legal in draw_replace phase after discarding; draw from stock (deck). If deck is exhausted, muck is shuffled to form new deck.

discard.description: Discard from zero to five cards from hand before receiving replacements in the draw_replace phase.
discard.constraints: Legal in draw_replace phase; must discard before drawing; number discarded determines number of replacements.

pass.reason: This game has no pass action.

bid.reason: This game has no bid action.

meld.reason: This game has no meld action.

go_out.reason: This game has no go-out action.

drawSources.notes: Replacements after discard in draw_replace phase; count equals number discarded.

customActions.description: Burn one card and deal three community cards face up (the flop).
customActions.constraints: Dealer only; after pre-flop betting round.

customActions.description: Burn one card and deal one community card face up (fourth street / turn).
customActions.constraints: Dealer only; after flop betting and draw round.

customActions.description: Burn one card and deal one community card face up (fifth street / river).
customActions.constraints: Dealer only; after turn betting round.

engine.deckDescription: A standard 52-card French deck comprising four suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades. Each suit contains thirteen ranks: Ace, 2 through 10, Jack, Queen, and King, providing versatile options for various card games.
engine.suitDescription: Suits and ranks are as defined in the deck description above; no separate suit or rank set is used for this game.
engine.rankDescription: Suits and ranks are as defined in the deck description above; no separate suit or rank set is used for this game.
engine.dealPattern: Five cards each; then flop (three board), draw round (discard 0-5, receive replacements), turn (one board), river (one board).

scoring.description: Pot is split between the best five-card hand (using only the player's five private cards) and the best Omaha hand (exactly two hole cards plus exactly three board cards). Same player can scoop both halves.
scoring.winCondition: Win one or both halves of the pot at showdown: best five-card hand and best Omaha hand (two from hand, three from board). Standard poker hand rankings for both.
scoring.splitRules: Pot splits 50/50 between best five-card hand (private) and best Omaha hand (2 hole + 3 board). Ties within a half split that half among winners.

nullReasons.targetScore: Cash game; no fixed target score. Hands are played for the pot.
nullReasons.scoringDirection: Scoring is chip-based; higher chip count is better but there is no round or session target.
nullReasons.cardValues: Poker uses hand rankings, not point values per card.
